cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Admit You Need Me
cards.instruction: Make someone admit that they need your help.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. That flat-pack cupboard's leaning. I could take a look.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Wonderful. Which page explains that leftover door?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you hold it for a second?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Certainly. Just to clarify: you're asking for my help?
